thread:
pagerbot: P1 ALERT — spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west after blue->green swap. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ai/llm-errors?orgId=1&from=now-15m
Maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it.
Jamal: I kicked the blue->green shift at 23:38 UTC, initial weight 70% green / 30% blue. No errors in canary at 10% earlier.
Priya: seeing inconsistent routing — some clients resolve eu-west to old blue IPs, others to new green. Could be DNS TTL / upstream resolver caches.
Liam: Support Ops reporting multiple customer sessions with repeated 504s and conversation truncation. CS ticket numbers: #2351, #2352.
Maria (oncall): Maria to Jamal — any infra changes on green nodes?
Jamal: nothing special, same instance image. But runtime logs show frequent model load failures on green, then fallback to smaller model, which returns 502/503.
Priya: observed OOM traces during KV cache restore on green-pool-3 leading to worker restarts.
Maria (oncall): Impact assessment: estimated ~7% request errors in eu-west, some high-value customers affected. Flagging customer-notify.
Support Ops: prepping customer-facing note. ETA 15m for an update.
Jamal: propose immediate kill-switch to stop weight shift and push all traffic back to blue while we debug. Flag is `features.bluegreen_geo_shift`.
Maria (oncall): how to flip? Need the exact command.
Jamal: run:
```
# rollback weights
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/flags/features.bluegreen_geo_shift -d '{"value":0}'
```
That will stop the orchestrator from moving more traffic to green and should flush new DNS weights.
Maria (oncall): doing kill-switch now, flipping flag to 0 — executing.
deploy-bot: action_log: user=Maria(flag_toggle) flag=features.bluegreen_geo_shift old=1 new=0 ts=1763456902
Maria (oncall): done. Not seeing immediate drop yet — DNS TTL may keep some clients going to green for a short window.
Priya: initiating targeted scaling on green to stabilize model loads (increase replicas of kv-recover service).
Liam: support: customers seeing partial recovery, error rate down from 7% -> 3% in last 5m. Still some sustained errors from specific ISPs.
Jamal: I'm going to scale down green pool and triage model checkpoint corruption on green-pool-3; will snapshot logs to S3 and open a JIRA.
Maria (oncall): handoff: I'm staying on-page for 30m, then hand to Jamal for remediation. @Support Ops please send customer update with root-cause in progress + mitigation steps.
Support Ops: posted update to affected customers and internal CS channel.
deploy-bot: deployment_event: blue->green-shift initiated by Jamal at 1763456318, aborted and weights frozen by Maria at 1763456902.
Priya: quick note for postmortem: check KV cache restore race on new instances, and DNS weight propagation strategy — consider staged TTL bumpdown next time.
Maria (oncall): creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime and infra. I'll annotate timeline and handoff notes.
Jamal: started a hotfix branch to add a stronger preflight for KV cache warmup.
Liam: CS asking about SLA impact. Current mitigation is routing back to blue; minimal customer-facing downtime expected beyond transient failures.
Maria (oncall): next steps: 1) continue green pool remediation, 2) verify DNS draining complete, 3) run a small controlled canary with metric gates, 4) full reattempt once fixes validated.
Priya: adding metric gates to the rollout job: error_rate < 0.5% and model_load_success=100% for 10m.
Maria (oncall): thanks all — I'll post final timeline + handoff to on-call rotation in 30m.
Jamal: uploading logs and opening ENG-4729.
Support Ops: CS notified customers that engineers are investigating and that traffic is routed to stable nodes.
Maria (oncall): incident status: mitigated -> partial recovery, P1 -> monitoring. Will escalate to P0 if errors climb.
pagerbot: Incident updated: mitigated at 1763457045. Refer to https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-338 for the timeline and artifacts. :white_check_mark:
